asset.name: Textarea
asset.description: The multi-line field with automatic resizing, character counting, minimum and maximum rows, validation treatment, and scroll-aware growth that never traps the page scroll.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, and radius resolve to declared ramps rather than literals.
Variant styling is declared as an enumerable recipe so the implementation is checkable against the catalog.
Controlled and uncontrolled operation share one contract and one event shape.
Auto-resize measures without forcing layout on every keystroke.
All class composition uses the shared Tailwind conflict resolver.
